meta.audit_note: Reality-check performed during PR copilot/update-documentation-sync (2026-03-09). NETWORK-MISSING-001 and NETWORK-MISSING-002 resolved 2026-03-10 (branch copilot/network-missing-001-implement-opcode-handlers).

missing_implementations.title: Wire Protocol V1 opcode handlers are stubs
missing_implementations.expected: Fully implemented dispatch handlers for all Wire Protocol V1 opcodes: HELLO, AUTH, GET, PUT, DELETE, QUERY, VECTOR_SEARCH, GEO_QUERY
missing_implementations.observed: 8 handlers in wire_protocol_server.cpp (lines 866–904) are stubs that call sendError(0x0003, '... not yet implemented'). No storage/index dispatch occurs.

evidence.stub_lines: wire_protocol_server.cpp lines 866–904 (9 TODO comments; file header reports TODOs: 9)
evidence.dispatch_table_lines: wire_protocol_server.cpp lines 714–735 (correct dispatch; handler body is stub)

missing_implementations.suggested_issue_title: [network] Implement WireProtocolServer V1 opcode handlers (HELLO, AUTH, GET, PUT, DELETE, QUERY, VECTOR_SEARCH, GEO_QUERY)
missing_implementations.fix_description: All 8 handlers implemented in src/network/wire_protocol_server.cpp: HELLO returns server capabilities; AUTH_REQUEST validates token and sets authenticated_; GET/PUT/DELETE dispatch to RocksDB; QUERY_AQL/GEO_QUERY return structured 501 redirect; VECTOR_SEARCH dispatches to VectorIndexManager::searchKnn. Additionally, src/themis/wire_protocol_server.cpp (protobuf-based) handlers implemented with auth checks and input validation.

missing_implementations.title: Token-based authentication not wired — authenticated_ flag never set true
missing_implementations.claim_section: Completed ✅ — Authentication (token-based) with configurable auth timeout
missing_implementations.expected: Token-based authentication: after successful AUTH sequence, authenticated_ is set to true; protected handlers (BPMN, etc.) accept authenticated sessions
missing_implementations.observed: handleAuthRequest() (wire_protocol_server.cpp:871–873) is a stub returning sendError(0x0003, 'AUTH not yet implemented'). authenticated_ (wire_protocol_server.h:412, std::atomic<bool> authenticated_{false}) is never set to true anywhere in the source. BPMN handlers that check authenticated_.load() (lines 1179, 1277, 1364) always return 401.
missing_implementations.suggested_issue_title: [network] Implement token-based authentication in WireProtocolServer (handleAuthRequest, set authenticated_ flag)
missing_implementations.fix_description: handleAuthRequest() implemented in src/network/wire_protocol_server.cpp: validates token against Config::auth_token (or dev-mode any-non-empty); sets authenticated_.store(true, memory_order_release); new Config::auth_token field added to include/network/wire_protocol_server.h.

missing_implementations.title: grpc_transport.cpp missing from cmake/CMakeLists.txt
missing_implementations.expected: src/network/grpc_transport.cpp compiled into themis_core / themis_network when THEMIS_ENABLE_GRPC=ON
missing_implementations.observed: src/network/grpc_transport.cpp was NOT listed in cmake/CMakeLists.txt (network section); the compilation unit was missing from the build despite a present source file and test coverage

evidence.cmake_section: cmake/CMakeLists.txt lines 1990–2002 (network section; grpc_transport.cpp absent before fix)

missing_implementations.title: WebSocket binary frame dispatch not implemented
missing_implementations.expected: Binary frames over WebSocket forwarded to wire protocol handler / storage dispatch
missing_implementations.observed: wire_protocol_server_ws.cpp receives binary frames but does not dispatch them to storage/index; clients receive a structured error response

evidence.roadmap_known_issue: ROADMAP.md §Known Issues: 'Binary frames over WebSocket are not yet dispatched'

missing_implementations.suggested_issue_title: [network] Dispatch binary WebSocket frames to wire protocol handler

summary.note: All other ROADMAP entries (V2 protocol, WebSocket upgrade, UDP fast-path, QUIC, gRPC transport, geo topology router, service mesh, QoS manager, connection pool, socket timeout manager) are backed by present implementation files and unit tests on the develop branch. The critical gap is the wire protocol V1 opcode handler stubs (NETWORK-MISSING-001/002), which make the binary wire protocol non-functional for database operations.
